entries.preset.quality-first.name: Quality First
entries.preset.quality-first.description: Keeps appearance first. Evaluates imported candidates against quality thresholds; the original is preserved when none qualify or validation is unavailable.
entries.preset.balanced.name: Balanced
entries.preset.balanced.description: Balances memory savings and appearance by evaluating imported candidates against quality thresholds; the original is preserved when none qualify or validation is unavailable.
entries.preset.size-first.name: Size First
entries.preset.size-first.description: Seeks greater memory savings by evaluating imported candidates against quality thresholds. Review flagged textures; the original is preserved when none qualify or validation is unavailable.
entries.preset.quality-first.impact: Candidates are evaluated against this preset’s quality thresholds. Only an acceptable validated candidate is applied; otherwise the original is preserved.
entries.preset.balanced.impact: Candidate formats and resolutions are evaluated adaptively against quality thresholds. The original is preserved when no acceptable candidate can be validated.
entries.preset.size-first.impact: More aggressive candidates are evaluated against quality thresholds. Review flagged textures; the original is preserved when no acceptable candidate can be validated.

entries.tip.useOptimizedOnBuild: Applies the generated optimized textures to a copy of the model during the VRChat build (via NDMF). The original model, materials and textures are never modified.
entries.tip.avatarField: The model root GameObject to analyze and optimize.
entries.tip.analyzeButton: Scans the model and its dependencies. Nothing is modified.
entries.tip.optimizeButton: Writes generated assets and a manifest. Original assets are never modified.
entries.tip.presetField: Controls how aggressive the optimization is. Hover the presets to see what they do.
entries.tip.languageField: Changes the interface language immediately and remembers the choice.
entries.tip.exclusionList: Textures listed here are never touched, whatever the preset says.
entries.tip.qualityEstimate: Estimates come from simulating the compression on the source pixels. They are not measurements of the final output.
entries.tip.qualityMeasure: Measurements are read back from a really generated and imported asset.
entries.tip.outputFolder: Generated files are written here. The folder is safe to delete; sources are never inside it.
entries.tip.changeTracking: Records the inputs the last optimization used, so only affected outputs are rebuilt.
entries.tip.compatibilityList: Third-party tools detected in this project. AvatarTuner never modifies their settings.
entries.tip.includeInactive: Also analyze GameObjects that are currently switched off. They are counted but never modified.
entries.tip.generateOptimizedPrefab: Writes a separate optimized prefab. The source prefab and hierarchy are not touched.
entries.tip.measureQuality: Slower but replaces estimated figures with measured ones where possible.
entries.tip.cleanup: Deletes generated files and their manifest entries. Original assets are never deleted.

entries.compat.title: Compatibility
entries.compat.noneFound: No known third-party optimization tools were detected.
entries.compat.notModified: AvatarTuner reads these tools' components for analysis only and never changes their settings.
entries.compat.conflictAvatarOptimizer: Avatar Optimizer (AAO) is present. Both tools can merge meshes and freeze blend shapes, so running both may change the result. Review its Trace And Optimize settings first.
entries.compat.conflictD4rk: d4rkAvatarOptimizer is present. It performs similar mesh and material merging at build time, so the two tools may disagree about what to keep.
entries.compat.conflictMultipleOptimizers: Two build-time optimizers are active on this avatar at the same time (Avatar Optimizer and d4rkAvatarOptimizer). Their merge and removal rules can disagree, so the editor state no longer predicts the build result. AvatarTuner refuses to modify this avatar and offers read-only analysis only.
entries.compat.ndmfPresent: NDMF is present. AvatarTuner does not hook into NDMF and produces its output outside the build pipeline, so NDMF will see the generated prefab as a normal avatar.
entries.compat.modularAvatarPresent: Modular Avatar is present. AvatarTuner never edits MA components, so any merge or parameter mapping they define is preserved unchanged.
entries.compat.vrcFuryPresent: VRCFury is present. Its components are treated as build-time dependencies and are listed as unconfirmed. SPS plugs and sockets are detected but never modified.
entries.compat.animatorDrivenSystem: An animation-driven system was detected: {0}. AvatarTuner only reports it and performs no changes to it.
entries.compat.manualInspection: Because of the above, please inspect the generated result manually before uploading.
